question: Compare the 2025 average completed order value of Enterprise and SMB customers. If Enterprise's is more than 20% higher than SMB's, break down Enterprise's 2025 completed revenue by product category; otherwise, break down SMB's 2025 completed revenue by product category.

sql_attempts.sql: WITH enterprise_smb_aov AS (SELECT c.segment, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS aov FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND c.segment IN ('Enterprise', 'SMB') GROUP BY c.segment), compare AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'Enterprise' THEN aov END) AS ent_aov, MAX(CASE WHEN segment = 'SMB' THEN aov END) AS smb_aov FROM enterprise_smb_aov) SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS completed_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id CROSS JOIN compare WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' AND c.segment = CASE WHEN compare.ent_aov > 1.2 * compare.smb_aov THEN 'Enterprise' ELSE 'SMB' END GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY completed_revenue DESC LIMIT 500
